title: Microsoft Teams: Multi‑camera view support for GCC-H and DoD in Teams Rooms on Windows
description: GCC-H and DoD cloud customers can now experience multi-camera views in Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows, allowing remote participants to switch between multiple in-room camera feeds for improved visibility and engagement in larger spaces. Find camera requirements here. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.
